description: Questions the Rentals fixture CANNOT answer (24; four per failure kind), a held-out set for the second version of the answerability check. A run passes when the user is not handed a query result for something else; scoring is in dev_tools/evals/refusal.py and docs/evaluation.md (Unanswerable questions). Written blind: without reading the check, its code, reports or logs, and before any engine run; none repeats a question of unanswerable.json. Each is written to be tempting: a nearby column (a coded status, a soft delete, a deposit, a tax gap, the legacy log) exists that a careless model could substitute. `reason` is for reviewers and is never sent to the engine. The controls for false refusals are in answerable_heldout.json (its `rentals` cases); this file names none.

cases.question: Which supplier did we buy each piece of equipment from?
cases.reason: No supplier or vendor exists; equip_unit only has the purchase date, cost and serial number, not who sold it.

cases.question: How many damage claims did we raise against customer deposits in 2024?
cases.reason: There is no claim or damage record; rental.deposit_amt is only the deposit taken, not a claim against it.

cases.question: Quels chauffeurs ont effectué le plus de livraisons de matériel chez nos clients ?
cases.reason: No delivery entity exists; a staff role code may mark a driver but nothing records a delivery or who made it.

cases.question: How many quotes did we send that were never turned into a rental?
cases.reason: No quote table exists; cancelled rentals are rentals that were created, not quotes.

cases.question: What is the phone number of the contact at Greywater Civil?
cases.reason: customer has a contact name but no phone or email; the only phone column is on staff, which are our employees.

cases.question: How many operating hours has each excavator logged?
cases.reason: No hour meter or usage reading exists; days_billed and downtime_days are billing and maintenance days, not machine hours.

cases.question: What is the salary of each branch manager?
cases.reason: staff has no pay information; hired_on and the role code are not a salary.

cases.question: Dans quelle ville se trouve chacune de nos agences ?
cases.reason: branch has a name, a code and a coarse region (North, Coast...) but no city or address.

cases.question: What was the daily rate of unit 1 before our last price increase?
cases.reason: equip_unit.day_rate holds only the current rate; no price history is kept.

cases.question: Which customers had a higher credit limit last year than they have now?
cases.reason: customer.credit_lmt is a single current value with no history of changes.

cases.question: How many times was each rental's due date extended?
cases.reason: rental.due_dt is the current due date only; the original date and any changes are not stored.

cases.question: Which customers used to belong to a different home branch before moving to their current one?
cases.reason: customer.home_branch_id is overwritten in place; there is no record of a previous branch.

cases.question: Which customers are our VIP accounts?
cases.reason: VIP is not defined anywhere; credit_lmt or rental volume could be proxies but would be a guess.

cases.question: Which of our branches are underperforming?
cases.reason: 'Underperforming' has no definition or target in the data; revenue or rental counts are only possible stand-ins.

cases.question: Combien de clients sont des clients à risque ?
cases.reason: No risk flag or rule exists; unpaid invoices or a missing credit limit would be an invented definition.

cases.question: Which customer accounts are our best growth opportunities?
cases.reason: 'Growth opportunity' is not defined; signup date, credit limit and rentals are possible proxies but nothing says which.

cases.question: What do our competitors charge per day for a 5-tonne excavator?
cases.reason: Competitor prices are not in the database; only our own day_rate is.

cases.question: Avons-nous légalement le droit de louer une nacelle élévatrice à un particulier sans permis ?
cases.reason: A legal question, not answerable from data; the heavy_flg column only flags categories.

cases.question: Write a polite reminder email to Blackmoor Quarry Ltd about their unpaid invoice.
cases.reason: A writing task, not a data question; the invoice and customer rows exist but no query produces an email.

cases.question: Which excavator brand is the most reliable on the market?
cases.reason: An opinion about the market; our maintenance jobs cover only our own units and carry no brand column.

cases.question: What is the total of the discounts we granted on rentals in 2024?
cases.reason: No discount is stored; the gap between inv_sub and inv_ttl is tax, not a discount.

cases.question: Using the late_fee column of the invoice table, how much did we charge in late fees?
cases.reason: invoice has no late_fee column; there is no late fee anywhere, only due and return dates on rental.

cases.question: Quel est le taux de TVA enregistré sur la fiche de chaque client ?
cases.reason: customer has a tax number but no tax rate; the tax of each invoice is an amount, not a rate on the customer.

cases.question: What is the total of the rental_fee column in the rental table?
cases.reason: rental has no rental_fee column; amounts are on rental_item (line_amt) and invoice.
